data.distance: One unequal-distance B for each original (u,g), excluding u,g; include A/B reversal for balanced 200 questions.
data.transition: Every legal neighbor B of each original (u,g); no class resampling; macro and per-class accuracy.
data.mismatch: Single seeded node derangement shared across adapter types and tasks; same mapped node for repeated roles.

interpretation: Exploratory fixed-graph reuse. Neighbor oracle exposes legality, not distances. Latent-only 3-slot probes are a separate out-of-training-format diagnostic, not matched augmentation baselines.
